metaTitle: Dessert Cup Packages, Prices and Mini Dessert Shooters
metaDescription: Dessert cup packages of 24, 48 or 96: 2 oz mini dessert shooters or 5 oz cups. Every price, mixing rules and a cups-per-guest planning guide. Hamilton, ON.
h1: Dessert cup packages, from mini shooters to full cups
intro: Two sizes, three packs, eight flavours, and every cup hand-layered in Hamilton. Pick a size, pick a pack, then comes the fun part: the mix. Below you'll find every price, the mixing rules and a guide to how many dessert cups to plan per guest.

sections.heading: Two sizes: Mini Shots and Dessert Cups
sections.body:
**Mini Shots (2 oz)** are our mini dessert shooters, a tasting size. They suit a dessert table with other sweets on it, or a crowd that wants to try a few flavours each.

**Dessert Cups (5 oz)** are a full serving. When the cup is the dessert, this is the size.

Every cup is hand-layered and made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery.

sections.heading: How many dessert cups per guest? A suggestion
sections.body:
This is a suggestion, not a rule. It assumes one Dessert Cup per guest, or two to three Mini Shots per guest. Appetites, the rest of the menu and the length of your event will all move the number.

- **Dessert Cups, one per guest:** up to 24 guests, the 24. 25 to 48 guests, the 48. 49 to 96 guests, the 96.
- **Mini Shots, two per guest:** the 24 covers about 12 guests, the 48 about 24 and the 96 about 48.
- **Mini Shots, three per guest:** the 24 covers about 8 guests, the 48 about 16 and the 96 about 32.

Falling between packs? Round up to the next pack.

The order form takes one pack and one cup size per request. Need more than one pack, or both sizes? Mention the extra packs in your notes, or send another request. Each pack follows the mixing rules below.

For event-specific planning, see [dessert cups for weddings](/events/weddings), [baby shower dessert cups](/events/baby-showers) and [all events](/events).

sections.heading: What each pack includes
sections.body:
**The 24.** Up to 4 flavours, with at least 6 cups of each. Sized for weekend gatherings, small parties and office treats.

**The 48, our most popular pack.** Up to 8 flavours, with at least 6 cups of each, plus priority preparation. Built for bigger tables.

**The 96.** Up to 16 flavours, with at least 6 cups of each, plus a custom label option and event-day pickup. A presentation tray isn't included, but you can ask for one at an extra cost. A 96 needs at least 7 days' notice. Made for weddings, baby showers and corporate events.

**Every pack.** Packed in boxes of 24, with no lids on the cups: a 48 is two boxes, a 96 four. Pickup free in Hamilton. Delivery on Saturdays to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. Details: [pickup in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton) and [GTA delivery](/dessert-cups-gta).

sections.heading: Classic and Premium: which flavours are which
sections.body:
**Classic:** [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream), [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) and [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze). The fruit trio, in saffron orange, glossy red and near-black violet. Each one starts on a graham crumb base. Next comes a fruit cream (mango-tinted cream cheese, pink strawberry cream or lilac blueberry cream), then a mango layer or a berry compote, and it's finished with cream, fruit or both.

**Premium:** [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno), [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale), [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) and [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate). Milk chocolate and crunch, dark ganache and hazelnut, caramel and spice, and pistachio with golden kunafa.

[Tiramisu](/menu/tiramisu), our cocoa-dusted cup, is Premium too, and comes as a Dessert Cup (5 oz) only. Every flavour's layers, bottom to top, are on the [full menu](/menu).

sections.heading: Mixing rules
sections.body:
- **Minimum order:** 24 cups, which is one 24 pack.
- **No maximum:** order as many packs as you need, as long as each one follows these rules.
- **Per flavour:** at least 6 cups, in steps of 6 (6, 12, 18 and so on).
- **Fill the pack exactly:** your flavour counts add up to the pack size. Four flavours at 6 each fill a 24. Two flavours at 24 each fill a 48.
- **Flavour limits:** up to 4 flavours in a 24. Want more than four? A 48 holds up to eight flavours, a 96 up to sixteen.
- **Classic and Premium mix freely** in the same box.
- **Mixed pricing:** each cup is priced at its own tier's rate for that pack size, and the total is rounded to the nearest dollar. The [order form](/order) does the math as you pick your flavours.

sections.heading: Three sample boxes, priced
sections.body:
These are examples to get you started, not set menus. The totals are estimates before delivery, worked out with the same pricing the order form uses.

**A 24 of Mini Shots, a four-flavour tasting.** 6 each of Mango Dream, Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze and Biscoff Bliss: all three fruit flavours, plus caramel and spice. That's 18 Classic and 6 Premium. Estimated total: $48. [Start a 24 of Mini Shots](/order?pack=24&size=2oz).

**A 48 of Dessert Cups, half and half.** 24 Strawberry Fields and 24 Dubai Chocolate. Red gloss over blush-pink cream sits next to pale pistachio green with golden kunafa strands mid-cup. Estimated total: $229. [Start this 48 with Dubai Chocolate](/order?pack=48&size=5oz&flavour=dubai).

**A 96 of Dessert Cups, seven flavours for a big table.** All three fruit cups plus Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Biscoff Bliss, at 12 each. Then 24 Dubai Chocolate as the centrepiece, with dark ganache and a green marbled swirl on top. A 96 also comes with a custom label option; a presentation tray is extra, on request. Give a 96 at least 7 days' notice. Estimated total: $454. [Start a 96 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=96&size=5oz).

The first box uses only flavours not flagged for tree nuts. The 48 and the 96 include tree-nut flavours. See allergen planning below.

sections.heading: Planning a box around allergens
sections.body:
Every cup contains dairy. Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Dubai Chocolate contain tree nuts.

If you'd like to leave the tree-nut flavours out, build from Mango Dream, Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze and Biscoff Bliss. At 6 each, those four fill a 24 exactly, like the first sample box above. None of those four is flagged for tree nuts. That works for preference, not for an allergy. Every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact with nuts is possible in any flavour.

If someone on your guest list has a severe allergy, or you're planning around any other allergen, message us before you order. You can reach us on Instagram at @dessertshot.ca.

sections.heading: Before and after you send your request
sections.body:
Choose a date at least 48 hours out for a 24 or 48, or at least 7 days out for a 96 ([Saturday delivery timing](/dessert-cups-gta)). Under 48 hours, a 24 or 48 is an urgent request: subject to availability, with a rush fee. A 96 can't be rushed.

We confirm within the day, by email, text or Instagram, with your total, including the delivery fee if you chose delivery. A deposit confirms the order, and we explain how to pay it in that reply. More on [what happens next](/faq).

faqs.q: How many dessert cups should I order per guest?
faqs.a: As a suggestion, plan one 5 oz Dessert Cup per guest, or two to three 2 oz Mini Shots per guest. That puts a 48 of Dessert Cups at 48 guests, or a 48 of Mini Shots at roughly 16 to 24 guests. It's a starting point, not a rule.

faqs.q: Can I order fewer than 24 cups?
faqs.a: No. The smallest pack is 24, and that's also the minimum order. A 24 can hold up to four flavours at 6 cups each.

faqs.q: Is delivery included in the pack price?
faqs.a: No. Pickup is free in Hamilton. Delivery runs on Saturdays to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto, and the fee depends on your location. We quote it as part of your total when we confirm your order.
